title: Kusile cost more than R160 billion #Eskom
text:
Eskom built two giant coal power stations, Medupi and Kusile, each about 4,800 megawatts. Kusile was budgeted at about R80 billion; it cost more than R160 billion and finished more than 11 years late, its last unit running only from September 2025. Together the two went more than R300 billion over budget, and Eskom borrowed the money.

Full guide: "How Eskom Went Broke, and What It Costs You Every Month (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
